newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy repatriates more Albanians, lull in exodus.
newsitem.headline: Italy repatriates more Albanians, lull in exodus.

text.p: Italy repatriated more Albanian "undesirables" on Friday as bad weather in the Adriatic caused a lull in the arrival of refugees and the military prepared for an eventual mission in Albania.
A group of 41 Albanians were flown back to Tirana from the southern port of Brindisi and a further 80 were to be repatriated later on Friday.
The repatriated Albanians either escaped from prison during the recent upheavals or broke Italian laws since they arrived.
Friday's repatriations would bring the total to more than 300 since the latest exodus began. Nearly 11,000 refugees have arrived in Italy since March 13 in a flotilla of more than 130 rusty boats.
Coastguard officials said they did not expect more boats to make the crossing on Friday because of rough seas and stiff winds in the channel between Albania and Italy's Puglia region.
The Italian navy is expected to begin patrolling Albanian territorial waters to deter the exodus as soon as negotiations between the two governments are complete, defence sources said.
